mutants.name: the stream presents the virtual page of a reused request
a reused request on the bus uses the stale physical page register
mutants.note: req_pa_q and lp_ppn_q are written together by every translation that fills the page, and nothing else writes req_pa_q, so a reused request's register already holds the kept page

mutants.name: streamed with translation on although the page is not kept
mutants.old: wire stream_reuse = PAGE_REUSE && i_xl_on && lp_valid_q && (fpc_q[63:12] == lp_vpn_q);

mutants.name: never streamed translated (the reuse ignored by the stream)
mutants.old: wire stream_reuse = PAGE_REUSE && i_xl_on && lp_valid_q && (fpc_q[63:12] == lp_vpn_q);
